:::{#exm-prediction-error-split}
#### The split in the best-predictor exercise

In @exr-best-predictor,
when $\Predvar = 0$ and $\Outvar = 0$,
the constant [prediction function](#def-prediction-function) $\predfn_1$, with $\predfn_1\paren{\Predvar} = 3$, has [prediction error](#def-prediction-error) $\prederrf{\predfn_1} = 3$.
The conditional mean is $\truemeanf{0} = 1$,
so $\prederrf{\truemean} = 1$ and $\devof{\predfn_1\paren{0}}{\truemeanf{0}} = 2$,
and $3 = 1 + 2$.

:::
